verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs say every SDK shares the same identity model, so 'a user instrumented once is understood everywhere,' and that the same API surface spans web, mobile, server, and game engines. This suggests a unified cross-platform identity layer. Nothing in the pack describes merging anonymous pre-signup activity into an identified profile, or how cross-device stitching works. Missing for 10: documented anonymous-to-identified merge/aliasing, explicit cross-device user stitching mechanics (user ID vs device ID resolution), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
